interactables.name: Tipped Saucer
interactables.text: A saucer, flipped on its back in a puddle of milk. Somebody knocked over [the saucer].|See the word in color? That is a CLUE. Finding one writes it into your casebook - it is already there.

interactables.name: Water Bowl
interactables.text: A [water bowl]. Full, upright, not a drop spilled.|Not every clue is part of the answer. Some are only there to make you think twice.

interactables.name: The Kitten
interactables.text: [The kitten] sits right next to the puddle, looking far too innocent. Milk on her whiskers. Every few seconds she tears around the room in circles - a classic case of [the zoomies].|Clues come in four colors: WHO, WHAT, WHERE/WHEN and WHY. Each color is a tab in your casebook.

interactables.name: The Old Dog
interactables.text: [The old dog] is fast asleep on his rug. He is always [hungry], but he has not moved in hours. The snoring proves it.|Most cases have more than one suspect. Your job is to work out who actually fits.
